rule.implemented: retainBatch releases the next file on receipt admission, stop or completion, not whole upload.
rule.admission: FIFO across profiles. Server quota alone decides room; no copied or raised client/server limit.
rule.active: An already admitted receipt sends and finalizes independently of the refused-create line.
rule.quotaWait: Only real slot UPLOAD_QUOTA; wake at freesAt or observed finalize/abort, with no fixed polling.
rule.limits: v1 <=134217728 bytes: 2/operator/case, 4 global. Larger v2: 1 global; counts separate by profile.
rule.preserve: Byte/storage quotas, 30-minute window, create replay binding, resend guards and every row word.
rule.wake: Versioned receipt-completion/abort notifications avoid lost wakeups during create round trips.
rule.rows: Quota row keeps server-count words; later unstarted rows use the existing earlier-file slot words.
rule.enrollment: Independent completion order, each source and outcome bound to its original row index.
rule.bounded: Small map/ZIP retain routes remain ordered until retention, but enrollment no longer gates next.
rule.stop: Stopped rows keep retry/cancel controls and release later files, including quota then non-quota failure.
rule.scope: retain-batch tests include batch-upload-progress.test.tsx: serial expectations now assert per-file order.
rule.serverRemainder: Cannot notify before an HTTP finalize/cleanup answer or retained status is observed. No server edit.

model.inputs: 17 recorded practice sizes; 15 batch rows in observed order. XLSX/CSV absent at first row sample.
model.hypothesis: FIFO admission with two v1 slots and one v2 slot starts the final small file before 180 seconds.
model.stop: One offline comparison; no tuning, server change or runtime rerun. Success needs sending, not admission.
model.assumptions: Fixed service times; no other receipts; immediate notification; six unknown services excluded.
model.limitations: Not exact send times. Receipt model omits pre-create/post-retention delays; row model keeps them.
model.after: Same FIFO two-v1/one-v2 model now matches the implemented admission rule; rerun unchanged offline.
model.target: 164.968 s admission with receipt service times; 220.114 s with row delays. Not proof of first-byte <180 s.
model.measurementGap: Exact send durations and six services unknown; no live after run, hash/network costs unmeasured.

tests.coverage: S1.3j FIFO/freesAt and S7.30 create replay/late-answer/part-resend still pass without quota polling.
acceptance: Two v1 sends overlap; third waits on real quota without reasking for 60 s, then wakes at finalize.
FIFO admission uses two v1 slots plus a separately counted single v2 slot.
freesAt makes no earlier create attempt; active finalize and pending enrollment do not block other sends.
A finalize during a refused round trip is not lost; quota then non-quota stop releases later admission.
Bounded retention enrollment also overlaps next upload; stopped-file controls and row words persist.
tests.realInputs: Niagara 4-part short-tail GeoJSON and NYC 6-part failed-part resume; 2 create replays passed.
tests.pins: No stale producer pins; no server/contract change.

designCheck.checkedNoIssue: Only scheduling/state reuse; no new helper text, screen, tokens, CSS or keyboard controls.
